Method of Attack: Leverages Log4Shell exploit (CVE-2021-44228) to execute base64-encoded PowerShell payload
Performs system enumeration, network validation, and C2 communications
Receives, decrypts, and loads additional modules for tasks like application enumeration, screenshot capture, process listing, system info gathering, remote command execution, and cleanup
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Apache Log4j Log4Shell vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228)
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Amazon S3 bucket controlled by threat actor
Presence of file Ni.txt in $APPDATA path
HTTP POST requests to google.com with parameter hi=hi
Use of 'Stack=Overflow' parameter in C2 communications
